read.text: ‪Ohm's Law‬ ‪Ohm's Law‬ is an interactive sim. It changes as you play with it. It has a Play Area and a Control Area. In the Play Area you find the equation for Ohm's Law, V equals I times R, and a circuit. Voltage and resistance sliders allow changes to the equation and circuit. In the Control Area, a button allows users to reset the sim. Right now, voltage, V, is 2.0 volts resistance, R, is 500
